meta.title: Switch to Midway Without Selling a Single Share | Midway Securities Ltd.
meta.description: Link your existing BO Account to Midway, 100% online. Same shares, same cost price, no transfer fee.

hero.headline: Switch to Midway Without Selling a Single Share
hero.subhead: Link your existing BO Account to Midway, 100% online. Your holdings, cost price and profit and loss stay exactly as they are.

items.title: Fill the Link BO Account Form
items.body: Submit the short online form in the Midway Portal. No branch visit.

items.title: We Open Your Link BO Account
items.body: Midway opens your Link BO Account and connects it to your existing BO Account.

items.title: Your Portfolio Moves As It Is
items.body: Your shares transfer at the same quantity and cost price.

items.title: Move Any Remaining Funds
items.body: Transfer any leftover cash from your old broker to Midway yourself.

stayTheSame.title: What Stays the Same
stayTheSame.intro: Switching changes who looks after your account, not what you own.

items.title: Quantity
items.body: You keep every share you own.

items.title: Cost Price
items.body: Your average buying price does not change.

items.title: Profit and Loss
items.body: Your gains and losses carry over as they are.

yourRights.title: Your Old Broker Cannot Say No
yourRights.body: Under BSEC and CDBL rules, your current broker cannot refuse the transfer as long as you have no margin loan or unpaid balance with them.
yourRights.note: Have a margin loan or dues? Message us on WhatsApp and we will guide you.

beforeYouStart.title: Before You Start
items: Settle any margin loan or unpaid balance with your current broker.
Keep your existing BO Account details handy.
Want a hand? We can walk you through it on WhatsApp.

items.title: QuickTrade Pro, Free
items.body: Android, iOS, desktop and web, with real-time data and advanced charting.

items.title: Midway Portal
items.body: Manage your account, IPO applications and withdrawals online.

items.title: Free Withdrawals
items.body: Withdraw to your own bank account at no charge, within 1 working day.

items.title: Real Support
items.body: Reach us on WhatsApp or the hotline, 09609 100 142.

items.q: Do I have to sell my shares to switch?
items.a: No. Your shares move as they are, at the same quantity and cost price.

items.q: Will my cost price or profit and loss change?

items.a: There is no fee to link your account.
About 1 working day after you submit the form.

items.q: What if I have a margin loan?
items.a: The transfer rule applies when there is no margin loan or unpaid balance. If you have one, message us on WhatsApp and we will guide you.

items.q: What happens to my leftover cash?
items.a: Once the link is done, transfer any remaining funds from your old broker to Midway yourself.

finalCta.title: Ready to Switch?
finalCta.body: Start your Link BO Account in the Midway Portal, or ask us anything on WhatsApp first.

disclaimer: Account transfers follow BSEC, DSE and CDBL rules. Investing involves risk, including loss of principal. No returns are guaranteed.
